C1320.title: Abusing Scheduled Tasks with Living off the Land Attacks
C1320.summary: CIS released guidance analyzing how attackers abuse Windows Scheduled Tasks to carry out Living off the Land attacks. Scheduled tasks are a common technique used by attackers to automate malicious activities, initiating infections, establishing persistence, and moving laterally. Malware families including Tarrask, RedLine, and Emotet have exploited scheduled tasks.
